title: 147871567 - 42-t-1127712-20060476F-001-001-2013
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence and articles regarding the Roswell incident and the International Roswell Initiative's petition for government openness, which concludes that the 1947 event involved a radar reflector rather than an extraterrestrial craft.

encounters.summary: Major Jesse Marcel, Sr. recovered debris from a ranch near Roswell, which he and others later claimed was of extraterrestrial origin, though the document identifies it as debris from an ML-307 radar reflector.
encounters.quote: It involved the recovery by the U.S. Military of material alleged to be of extraterrestrial origin.
